messages:
Elliot Price: heads up — need to lock down the new onboarding landing page URLs + the deep-link conventions from Console checklist this week. main question: who owns redirects + versioned URLs (docs vs console)?

Wei Chen: +1. the current onboarding stuff is spread across /docs/getting-started and /docs/api. if Console is going to deep-link, we need canonical URLs that won’t move every time we tweak nav.

Jean-Paul Laurent: also: we keep getting “link rot” issues from in-product links when we do IA refactors. would love to set the rule: Console links only to stable “/docs/…” paths, and docs site handles redirects to latest.

Marissa Cole: from Console side we can’t chase redirects forever. we need a stable contract: one URL per checklist step, ideally not tied to sidebar structure. i’m fine if docs owns redirects as long as there’s a process + SLA-ish expectation.

Wei Chen: proposal: create a top-level landing page:
- /docs/onboarding (new)
- /docs/onboarding/first-request
- /docs/onboarding/streaming
- /docs/onboarding/production-launch
- /docs/onboarding/troubleshooting
Then Console deep-links to those only.

Elliot Price: yes. that matches the checklist step list better than “getting-started”. but we need to decide versioning. ex: /docs/onboarding/production-launch should stay stable, and content can update, but we may need “pinned” version for audit/support screenshots.

Jean-Paul Laurent: could do versioned aliases like /docs/v1/onboarding/production-launch that redirects to current unless pinned? or keep /docs/onboarding stable, and git tags are our “version” (not user facing).

Marissa Cole: Console needs one stable URL. if you add /v1 later, we can update (but prefer not). i think stable = /docs/onboarding/... and if we need snapshots, that’s docs tooling, not Console.

Wei Chen: for attribution we also need UTM conventions. design asked for a consistent scheme so they can see which checklist step drove the click.

Elliot Price: yep. thinking:
- utm_source=console
- utm_medium=onboarding_checklist
- utm_campaign=hosted_api_onboarding
- utm_content=<step_id>
And step_id should be a stable slug (not the visible copy).

Hannah Rivera: jumping in from Console implementer POV — we can do that. we already have step IDs in config. we can append UTMs on click.

Nikhil Sharma: quick check: is there any reason to include org/project IDs in query params? analytics asked at some point.

Elliot Price: pls no. we don’t want any customer identifiers in doc URLs. also privacy review will block it.

Jean-Paul Laurent: +1. also: avoid putting model names in URL if they change. “first-request” is good.

Wei Chen: redirect ownership: if we move /docs/getting-started/first-request -> /docs/onboarding/first-request, who sets redirect? docs team can add Netlify/edge redirects in docs repo. but we need to know when Console ships links so we don’t break.

Marissa Cole: Console release train for beta is ~2-3 weeks. we can share final list of URLs + UTMs in the PRD/UX spec. but if docs changes URLs later, can you guarantee redirect stays?

Elliot Price: yes, docs will own:
1) canonical URL list for checklist steps
2) redirects for any previous URLs
3) redirect tests in docs CI (basic 301/302 checks)
Console owns:
1) only linking to canonical URLs + UTMs
2) not hardcoding old URLs in multiple places (single config)

Hannah Rivera: works for us. can we get the final canonical list today? we’re wiring deep links + need to stop guessing.

Wei Chen: draft list (tell me if any step naming mismatch):
- /docs/onboarding (landing)
- /docs/onboarding/api-keys
- /docs/onboarding/first-request
- /docs/onboarding/streaming
- /docs/onboarding/structured-output
- /docs/onboarding/retries-timeouts
- /docs/onboarding/rate-limits-quotas
- /docs/onboarding/observability
- /docs/onboarding/production-launch
- /docs/onboarding/troubleshooting

Marissa Cole: looks right. note: in checklist we call it “Usage & costs dashboard” not “observability” but close enough. step_id can stay “observability”.

Jean-Paul Laurent: redirect plan: we should also add redirects from old docs URLs like:
- /docs/quickstart -> /docs/onboarding
- /docs/getting-started -> /docs/onboarding
and keep them for at least 12 months.

Elliot Price: agreed. also we should avoid “latest” in URL. stable paths only. ok next action items:
- Wei: open docs PR with new /docs/onboarding landing + stub pages + nav entry. include redirect rules.
- Jean-Paul: write up deep-link + UTM conventions as a short snippet to drop into the UX spec.
- Marissa/Hannah: point Console to these canonical paths; do not link to sidebar-generated URLs.

Wei Chen: on it. will ping once PR is up for review.

Hannah Rivera: ty. once we have the final list i’ll update our config + add a unit test that each step has a canonicalDocUrl.

Nikhil Sharma: pls also make sure troubleshooting page has the common 401/429/streaming disconnect bits. those are the top blockers.

Elliot Price: yep — troubleshooting will be part of the onboarding cluster. we’ll link support macros there too.

Wei Chen: ok sending the canonical list to the docs thread in #product too so everyone aligns.

Elliot Price: perfect. :thumbsup:
